page_note: First structural unit (0-23) is dense cosmological substrate teaching: the ascent of the Living Soul through the Virgin of Light to the New Man / Indweller, with the trichotomy somatikon / psychikon / pneumatikon. This is core correspondential teaching — purification, the seal, the icon, the robe. Second unit (24-29) is a chapter heading (115) followed by a catechumen's question to the apostle about post-mortem rest and the supplications of the holy ones — institutional/ecclesial frame plus dialogue attribution. Third unit (30-32) opens a new narrative scene with the catechumen in the assembly. Strong second-half editorial drift confirmed by scores. Heavy damage (75.8%) but the surviving teaching is structurally clear.
